architecture_section: architecture.md, section 21, Definition of Done for the complete P0 program

findings.detail: WP-25's own prose declares 14 Definition of Done items; architecture.md, section 21, Definition of Done for the complete P0 program enumerates 15. The two counts disagree.
findings.resolution: all 15 enumerated bullets are implemented as P0-DOD-001 through P0-DOD-015 and evaluated separately. No bullet was merged, renumbered or discarded to reach the declared count. The discrepancy is visible and it permits no item to be ignored.

items.architecture_text: One integrated web prototype runs the representative workflow.

blockers.detail: C9: the API has served at least one real assessment (observed 0, required >= 1)
C1: at least one assessment has been computed from governed content (observed 0, required >= 1)

items.notes: the prototype exists and renders; what it has never rendered is a result computed from an approved dataset and ruleset
items.observable_condition: the web prototype computes and displays an assessment produced from governed content, end to end, at least once

items.architecture_text: Assessment facts are deterministic for the same release and input.

blockers.detail: C8: a release is active (observed False, required is true)
C1: at least one assessment has been computed from governed content (observed 0, required >= 1)

items.notes: determinism is demonstrated over fixtures; 'for the same release' has no referent while no release is active
items.observable_condition: the same input, evaluated twice against the same release, produces byte-identical facts - which requires a release to exist

blockers.detail: C4: at least one report has been produced (observed 0, required >= 1)

items.notes: no report has been produced, so the property holds vacuously and is recorded as unsatisfied rather than as met
items.observable_condition: each finding in a produced report resolves to a governed evidence record

items.architecture_text: Missing data is never shown as low/no risk; coverage is separate.

blockers.detail: C2: at least one coverage manifest has been executed (observed 0, required >= 1)
C3: at least one axis is supported by governed coverage (observed 0, required >= 1)

items.notes: the invariant is implemented and proven over fixtures; it has never been exercised over governed content because none exists
items.observable_condition: coverage is computed over governed content and rendered as its own axis, never folded into a risk value

items.architecture_text: Software, dataset, and ruleset are independently versioned and rollback works.

blockers.detail: A2: a canonical dataset is published (observed False, required is true)
B5: at least one ruleset is frozen (observed 0, required >= 1)
E6: the deployment gate reports PASS in its own artifact (observed 'BLOCKED', required == 'PASS')

items.notes: the registry design is implemented; no dataset is published, no ruleset is frozen, and no rollback has been executed
items.observable_condition: three independent version identifiers exist for one running system, and a rollback between two released versions has been executed

items.architecture_text: At least 50 serious validation cases exist, with a preference for 100+.

blockers.detail: D1: at least fifty validation cases exist (observed 0, required >= 50)

items.notes: zero exist; the seven development cases are excluded by contract and must never be counted towards this bullet
items.observable_condition: the validation case store holds at least fifty authored cases

items.architecture_text: An independent holdout set was not used for rule development.

blockers.detail: D2: an independent holdout set exists (observed 0, required >= 1)

items.notes: the separation audit runs and passes over seven development cases, which is a check with nothing to separate them from
items.observable_condition: a holdout set exists and the separation audit shows no case in it influenced rule development

items.architecture_text: All safety invariants pass in CI.

blockers.detail: C6: the safety invariants have been executed by a CI provider (observed False, required is true)
C5: the safety gate reports PASS in its own artifact (observed 'BLOCKED', required == 'PASS')

items.notes: twelve invariants execute locally and pass; the workflow file is configured and has never been run by a provider
items.observable_condition: a continuous integration provider has executed the safety gate and recorded every invariant passing

items.architecture_text: Blind-first expert review is completed under the approved protocol.

blockers.detail: D6: the expert review protocol has a signatory (observed 0, required >= 1)
D8: at least one expert review is completed (observed null (no measurement was taken), required >= 1)

items.notes: the review machinery is implemented and empty; no protocol signatory and no named reviewer exist
items.observable_condition: the protocol carries a signatory and at least one blind-first review is recorded complete

items.architecture_text: Experts use the representative workflow, not only static reports.

blockers.detail: D7: at least one expert reviewer is named (observed 0, required >= 1)
D9: the expert review gate reports PASS in its own artifact (observed 'BLOCKED', required == 'PASS')

items.notes: an eight-step workflow is implemented; nobody has walked it
items.observable_condition: a completed review records that the reviewer used the interactive workflow

blockers.detail: D3: at least one validation metric has a computed value (observed 0, required >= 1)
D5: a benchmark has been executed against the active release (observed False, required is true)

items.notes: fifteen metric definitions exist and no metric has a value; a definition is not a measurement
items.observable_condition: at least one metric has a computed value attributed to a named release

items.architecture_text: Audit records actor/time/input hash/version bundle/output hash.

blockers.detail: E4: the audit chain has been verified against a real store (observed None, required is true)
E2: a governed database is reachable (observed False, required is true)

items.notes: 41 governed actions and the chain structure are implemented; no audit store has ever existed to write one
items.observable_condition: governed audit events exist in a real store and the hash chain verifies

items.architecture_text: A staging prototype, health checks, and basic reliability report exist.

blockers.detail: E9: a staging environment has been deployed (observed False, required is true)
E7: a container runtime is available (observed False, required is true)

items.notes: the Dockerfile, compose topology, health endpoints and drill catalogue are implemented; no runtime answered, so nothing was deployed or measured
items.observable_condition: a staging environment has been deployed, its health endpoint observed answering, and a reliability report produced from executed drills

items.architecture_text: Every THS 6 claim links to a concrete artifact or metric.
items.notes: this is the one bullet WP-25 itself can satisfy: the claim registry links every claim to named artifacts, and the traceability matrix refuses a dangling identifier
items.observable_condition: every registered claim names required evidence, and each named item resolves to an artifact present in the repository

items.architecture_text: Core demo completes with network unavailable, LLM off, and every P1 feature off.

blockers.detail: F4: the interface reports a populated validation dashboard (observed 'EMPTY_STATE_ONLY', required == 'POPULATED')

items.notes: the interface renders offline with the model off, which is half the bullet; it renders an empty state because there is no governed content to display
items.observable_condition: the representative demonstration runs to completion offline, with the language model disabled and every P1 feature off, and produces a result rather than an empty state

note: Every enumerated bullet is evaluated separately. An unevaluated item is not a satisfied one, and no aggregate here rounds anything up.
